An essay is a brief piece of writing on a particular subject or topic. There are two different types of essays that can be written: formal essays and informal essays. Writings that are primarily scholarly in nature are called formal essays. Contrarily, an informal essay is one that is written for both the writer and the reader's enjoyment. Due to the fact that essay writing is employed in many selection tests for further education and even employment, every student must be able to write one. Whether an applicant is applying to a school or for an essay competition, their essay will be taken into consideration when deciding which candidates to shortlist.

You may learn how to write an essay from start to finish by reading this post. Read on for guidance to see how to write an essay like a professional!

How To Write an Essay

Before learning the format for writing an essay, let's look at some types of essays:

Narrative Essays: The author of a narrative essay will describe an event or a story. A simple five-paragraph essay is much more like a narrative essay. One specific instance serves as the focal point of the entire article.

Persuasive Essays: In persuasive essays, the author will persuade the audience to agree with their point of view. Getting the reader to agree with your position on the issue is the essay's primary goal in this instance. Here, the author will essentially offer a situation and write either in favor of or against it.

Expository Essays:  The writer will typically explain, illustrate, clarify, or elaborate about a specific topic in expository essays. An investigation, assessment, or even an argumentation on a concept in need of clarification can all be used in an expository essay.

Descriptive Essays: The author of a descriptive essay may discuss a setting, an item, an emotion, or even a specific individual. The writer will here elaborate on the subject by utilizing all five of his or her senses: touch, taste, smell, hearing, and sight.

How To Write an Essay Format

Here is a structure for how to write an essay step by step guide, which is provided below. Students must follow these 7 steps to write an essay like a pro:

Step 1: Choosing a Topic

A topic on which to write an essay must be selected by the author before writing anything. After choosing a subject, take a seat quietly and begin thinking about it. Make a list of all your ideas and, based on the subject you have chosen, decide what kind of essay to write.

Step 2: Create an Outline

Now, based on the concepts you have in mind, draught an outline to help you structure your thoughts. Diagrams are another useful tool for expressing your ideas. You will be able to connect the concepts or points in your essay and ensure that it flows properly once you have produced an outline.

Step 3: Create a thesis assertion

The thesis statement, which explains the topic of the essay, is a crucial sentence in an essay. Put your thesis statement in the opening paragraph, make sure you reference it throughout the essay, and then reiterate it in the summary and conclusion.

Step 4: Essay's Substantial Content

This is the section of the essay where you need to go into great detail on the subject. Every single remark should start with an attention-getter. Start your essay, for instance, with a dialogue, a story, or even a brief synopsis. But keep in mind that every assertion you make should relate to your thesis.

Step 5: Introduction

Once your thesis and the main body of your essay are complete, you must begin writing the introduction. The opening sentence ought to grab the reader's interest.

Step 6: Conclusion

Now comes the conclusion. The major themes of your essay should be summed up in your conclusion. The conclusion must also have three to five solid sentences, at least.

Step 7: Final Specifications

Examine the paragraph order when you've finished writing your article. Check the reasoning behind each assertion and each paragraph you used in the essay. Avoiding grammar errors and editing language. After that, reread the entire document from the user's point of view to confirm that it is easy to understand.

How To Write a Good Essay – checklist

  • My essay is formatted precisely in accordance with the Guidelines/requirements (length and topic)
  • My introduction captures the reader's attention and provides any background details about the subject that is required.
  • My thesis statement, which summarizes the main idea of the essay, is included in the introduction.
  • The paragraphs of the essay are well organized.
  • Don't forget to begin each paragraph with a topic sentence.
  • A distinct thesis statement has been the focus of every paragraph.
  • I distinguish between paragraphs and thoughts with clear transitions.
  • In addition to making links between arguments, the essay's conclusion does more than simply restate the points made in the main body.
  • Don't include any additional justifications or supporting details in the conclusion.
  • For each quote or piece of information used from another source, an in-text reference is required.
  • Make sure to add a bibliography section with a complete list of all the sources at the end of my essay.
  • Citations and references are formatted properly.
  • The title of my essay is engaging and informative.
  • The formatting requirements have been properly followed (e.g., font, page numbers, line spacing).
